title: 经典叙事：Pride and Prejudice（公版节选）
source: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
attribution: Jane Austen, Pride and Prejudice, chapter 1 (1813)
purpose: 保留叙述立场和反讽；公版参考，不是标准答案

title: 学术约束：数字、引用与不确定性（自编）
source: A pilot study of 48 participants found that the intervention may improve recall after 14 days. The observed difference was 7.5%, but the study did not establish causality. Working memory—temporary storage used during cognitive tasks—was assessed separately. These findings should not be generalized beyond this sample (Taylor, 2021).
purpose: 合成测试，不代表真实研究；检查数字、定义、否定、引用与 may 的保护

title: 商业约束：目标与实际结果（自编）
source: The team aims to reduce processing time by 15% in 2027. This figure is a target, not an achieved result. The current workflow requires two manual reviews, and neither review may be removed without approval. A smaller pilot could help identify bottlenecks before a wider rollout.
purpose: 合成测试；不得把目标改成已经实现的结果，不得改变审批限制
